newsitem.title: USA: Walden says to buy Drever for $670 mln.
newsitem.headline: Walden says to buy Drever for $670 mln.

text.p: Walden Residential Properties Inc said Friday it has signed an agreement to buy the privately held Drever Partners Inc for $670 million.
Walden said the deal would give it total market capitalization exceeding $1.5 billion.
Walden said the deal consists of $380 million in stock warrants and cash, and $290 million of assumed debt.
The deal is expected to close by October.
Walden said deal will create a REIT with about 41,000 apartment units.
Drever's 18,100 apartment units are located in Texas, Arizona, Georgia and California. Walden's 22,900 units are located the southwest and southeast regions of the United States.
